## Strongly supported transformation hypothesis from 5 demos
A same-color straight bar/segment appears on two opposite grid boundaries. One segment is a translated copy of the other (same length/orientation, shifted parallel to the boundary). Sparse singleton marker(s) inside the grid have a different color. For each marker, extend a straight ray perpendicular to the boundary from the marker toward the boundary segment on the same side/coordinate frame; recolor intervening background cells with the marker's original color and change the marker itself to color 4. Then translate the marker's position by the displacement between the two boundary segments and draw the counterpart ray/line from the opposite boundary, across the grid. Preserve both boundary bars and all unrelated background.

For horizontal boundary bars at top/bottom, a marker at column c within the top segment's horizontal extent maps to opposite bottom column c + (bottom_start - top_start); top-side ray runs from row 1 through the marker, and the mapped bottom-side ray runs all the way up to row H-2. For a bottom-side marker, conversely the near-bottom ray runs upward to marker and mapped top ray runs full height. For vertical bars, exchange row/column roles. Markers map to corresponding cells by their offset within the length-N bars, not necessarily same absolute coordinate.

### Demo evidence
1. 12x8, bg 0, color-6 segments top row c5-7, bottom row c0-2 (shift -5); singleton 1 at (r2,c7). Output has 1 along c7 from top to r1, marker becomes 4 at (r2,c7), and full counterpart line c2 rows0-10 (except bottom bar). This corresponds to offset 2 in each segment.
2. 10x6, bg1, color-5 top segment c2-3, bottom c0-1 (shift -2); singleton 0 at (r7,c2), marker becomes4. Output has 0 along c2 rows1-6, and full mapped counterpart c0 rows0-8. Marker is near bottom; rays reverse side.
3. 13x28, bg3, color-0 vertical bars left c0 rows3-7 and right c27 rows8-12 (shift +5 rows); markers 1 at (r6,c3) and (r7,c20), each becomes4. ## Unsolved test exact input facts
Grid 14x11, background 7. Top bar color2 at row0 cols3-5. Bottom bar color2 at row13 cols0-2 (offset shift -3). Markers color3 at (r3,c4), (r7,c3), (r7,c5). Do not store any failed grid as correct. The rule is an evidence-based inference, but test-side ray-direction/overlap may still need confirmation if task recurs.

Earlier submissions repeatedly expanded the color-3 region across extra columns or whole rows. Do not fill the full horizontal bar span, and do not fill any cells beyond the selected marker-aligned perpendicular rays.
